# routeros_console_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `log_script_errors` (Boolean) Whether errors produced by scripts are written to the system log.
- `sanitize_names` (Boolean) Whether the console replaces characters that need quoting in names with a safe equivalent when a configuration is exported.
- `tab_width` (Number) Number of spaces a tab character expands to in the console output (1..8).

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
